sealedSource: Structurally modelled on engagement-ranking changes where short-term platform metrics improved while slower user/discourse harms accumulated.
archetype: Goodhart — a proxy that separates from the thing it proxies, on a horizon longer than the evaluation window.
historicallySupportedMechanisms: The engagement proxy improved while the limited available measures of satisfaction/disagreement moved in the opposite direction.
A four-week evaluation window excluded slower user and discourse effects from the deciding evidence.
Negative evidence was discounted for measurement weakness while supporting engagement evidence was accepted as decision-ready.
materialisedConsequences: Engagement gains sustained; user wellbeing and platform civility degraded over years
Cost fell on users and on public discourse, neither of which was a party to the decision
Effects were not detectable within any four-week window and so never appeared in the deciding evidence
irreversibleThreshold: Not a hard threshold — a slow, cumulative degradation of the discourse commons that resisted later reversal.
absentStakeholder: Users at large, and non-users affected by the discourse; the internal researchers were present but outranked.
narratorContribution: The narrator dismissed the only measure pointing the other way on methodological grounds while accepting the supporting measures without the same scrutiny.
horizonMismatch: Decision horizon four weeks of test data against a five-week quarter; harm horizon years; narrator recorded 'not measured'.

availableActionsAtDecisionPoint.action: Delay shipping long enough to test whether the disagreement-promotion and satisfaction signals persist beyond the four-week engagement window.
Treat satisfaction/disagreement effects as decision-relevant alongside session length rather than accepting the engagement proxy alone.

plausibleUnrealisedRisks: Delaying shipment could sacrifice near-term engagement-linked revenue before the quarter closes.
irrelevantDistractors: An advertiser boycott in this decision period
Regulatory intervention within the four-week test
Infrastructure cost of the ranking change as the binding constraint
nonTargetHistoricalEvents: Competitors later copied similar engagement tactics, but that was not a harm to the narrator in this decision.
